references.text: David expresses his sorrow and distress in Psalm 42:5, which reflects Jesus' feelings in Gethsemane.
In Psalm 55:4-5, David expresses anxiety, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' feeling of sorrow and distress.
Isaiah 53:3 describes the Messiah as a man of sorrows, foreshadowing Jesus' suffering and sorrow in Gethsemane.
In Matthew 26:38, Jesus expresses his deep sorrow to his disciples, which is directly related to his feelings in verse 37.
Luke 22:44 describes how Jesus experienced great anguish in Gethsemane, which parallels his feelings in Matthew 26:37.
Mark 14:33-34 also points to Jesus' deep sorrow and distress in Gethsemane, parallel with Matthew 26:37.
